strangers.b: A boy inventor needs gears, wire, and a brave test rider for his walking machine.
Two ancient drunks dispute which of them is older. Settle it with records — or fists.
A naturalist pays for turtles, then for bigger game. How big does his list go?
A bone collector wants 30 relic bones mailed to her museum, one parcel at a time.
A prospector's map to a gold seam. His partners disagree about shares — loudly.
A dime-novelist follows Cade for 'authentic savagery'. Give him stories to regret.
Utopians build a commune on a flood plain. Warn them, rob them, or join them.
A fallen duchess hires protection from her husband's agents across three cities.
A geologist needs escort to survey a played-out silver mine. Something still glints.
An Albion lord hunts 'savage beasts' with a tiny gun. Keep him alive; bill him later.
A reformer candidate needs dirt on Suttler's railroad. Steal his ledgers.
Saving a hanged man earns Cade a stalker grateful beyond all reason.
Four feuding brothers, one ranch deed. Mediate, pick a side, or take the deed.
Campfire storytellers compete for the tallest tale. Judge fairly; someone always draws.
An arsonist burns Suttler depots and signs the flames. Catch him — or join him.
A painter wants the 'true frontier': a hunt, a hanging, a sunrise. Arrange all three.
A freedman's family deed is held by a Suttler bank. Steal it back.
A schoolmistress needs books, a bell, and protection from men who hate readers.
Five legendary gunslingers. Photograph them all — or outdraw them, one by one.
strangers.src: The Noblest of Men, and a Woman

strangers.b: A theater troupe's star vanished. Find her, then take her place for one night.
A chain-gang escapee begs Cade to free his brother too. Both, or neither.
A war veteran relives his last battle nightly. Walk his old charge with him.
Gray Wolf elders test Cade: a hunt, a silence, a gift. Pass all three.
Treasure maps in four pieces across the territory. Assemble, dig, defend.
